name: Ambiguous search regression
purpose: Competing pre-onset commits and weak trace evidence produce an honest low-confidence, no-clear-culprit interpretation.

expected.interpretation: No clear culprit is established because two plausible changes have competing evidence and the traces do not identify an owned line.

caveats: The supplied traces point to a shared dependency and do not identify an application-owned changed line.
A low-confidence ranking is not evidence that either plausible commit caused the regression.
